Name: Healthy
Keywords: healthy; nominal; steady state; ok; baseline; normal operation
Static Encoding: solid stroke; normal fill; NO chip -- absence of exception chips is the healthy signal
Color Guidance: role tokens unchanged
Reduced-Motion Fallback: heartbeat stops; solid stroke and normal fill remain
Use When: default resting state; answers how to mark a node as fine
Don't: never add a HEALTHY chip -- chips mark exceptions and a chip on every node is noise

Name: Degraded
Keywords: degraded; partial outage; impaired; elevated latency; warning; unhealthy
Static Encoding: stroke-dasharray 6 3 plus DEGRADED chip; both always visible
Color Guidance: chip fill = role token; ring uses role accent
Reduced-Motion Fallback: dash pattern and chip persist; pulse stops
Use When: component is up but impaired -- slow replies; partial capacity; failing health checks intermittently
Don't: never motion-only -- the dash and chip are the guaranteed channel; the pulse is garnish

Name: Down
Keywords: down; dead; crashed; outage; offline; failed node
Static Encoding: sparse dash 2 6; fill at 40% opacity; error-role stroke; DOWN chip
Color Guidance: stroke = error role; chip fill = error role with on-color text
Reduced-Motion Fallback: identical -- a dead node has no animation by design (dead = still)
Use When: node has failed; failover stories; the motion belongs to the REROUTE EDGES around it never the corpse
Don't: never animate the dead node itself once it has fallen -- stillness is the meaning (collapse-death is the ONE-SHOT dying moment at the window's start; never a loop); never encode down by fill alone

Name: Overloaded
Keywords: overloaded; saturated; queue full; spike; hot; at capacity
Static Encoding: fill-level bar near top of shape plus numeric chip; the number comes from the solution sheet
Color Guidance: bar uses role accent; past threshold switch bar to error role
Reduced-Motion Fallback: bar parked at its current fill level; chip persists
Use When: traffic spike; saturation; the tier-transition trigger in progressive diagrams
Don't: never a bare red glow -- the NUMBER is the story; chip without the number is decoration

Name: Throttled
Keywords: throttled; rate limited; 429; quota exceeded; shedding; slowdown
Static Encoding: valve tick where the inbound edge joins the node plus 429 chip
Color Guidance: chip fill = role token; rejected-packet tint = error role
Reduced-Motion Fallback: valve tick and chip persist; gate animation stops
Use When: rate limiter engaged; quota exhausted; admission control active
Don't: never show throttling only as slower animation speed -- speed differences are invisible in stills

Name: Scaling Out
Keywords: scaling out; autoscale; spawning replicas; scale up; growing; provisioning
Static Encoding: ghost OUTLINE appearing beside the node (stroke-only silhouette per stack rule) plus +N chip
Color Guidance: ghost stroke = --stroke token at reduced opacity
Reduced-Motion Fallback: ghost outlines parked visible; chip persists
Use When: autoscaling event; capacity being added mid-story
Don't: ghosts are outline-only -- never full-body copies; never leave the +N chip off (count is the fact)

Name: Cold Start
Keywords: cold start; warming; booting; startup; uninitialized; loading model
Static Encoding: dotted stroke 1 3 plus COLD chip; muted fill until warm
Color Guidance: fill dimmed toward canvas; stroke = role token
Reduced-Motion Fallback: dotted stroke and chip persist; boot sequence stops at the warm frame
Use When: lambda cold starts; model weights loading; cache warming windows
Don't: never reuse is-down visuals -- cold is expected and transient; error role is wrong here

Name: Draining
Keywords: draining; drain; rolling deploy; connection draining; graceful shutdown; cordoned
Static Encoding: single-direction hatch overlay plus DRAIN chip; inbound edges thin
Color Guidance: hatch uses --stroke at low opacity
Reduced-Motion Fallback: hatch and chip persist; shedding animation stops
Use When: rolling deploys; node cordoned; traffic being moved off deliberately
Don't: never error role -- draining is intentional; distinguish from is-down explicitly in the legend

Name: Syncing
Keywords: syncing; replication lag; catching up; behind; replica sync; eventual consistency
Static Encoding: double-line stroke on the sync edge side plus LAG chip carrying the number
Chip Text: LAG 2s (the lag from the solution sheet)
Color Guidance: sync edge uses async role
Reduced-Motion Fallback: double line and chip persist; sync pulse stops
Use When: replica catching up; cross-region sync; consistency-lag stories
Don't: chip must carry the measured lag -- LAG without a number claims nothing

Name: Leader
Keywords: leader; primary; master; elected; writer; coordinator
Static Encoding: heavier stroke width plus LEADER chip
Color Guidance: stroke = role token one step heavier than the element's CURRENT stroke weight -- relative; never a fixed step over the base --stroke-w
Reduced-Motion Fallback: heavier stroke and chip persist; election pulse stops
Use When: consensus groups; primary-replica topologies; the write path owner
Don't: never mark leader by color alone -- stroke weight plus chip are the channels

Name: Follower
Keywords: follower; secondary; standby; replica role; reader; hot standby
Static Encoding: normal stroke plus FOLLOWER chip
Color Guidance: role tokens unchanged
Reduced-Motion Fallback: identical -- static by definition
Use When: the read-path peers of an is-leader node; always paired with one is-leader
Don't: never used without a visible is-leader partner -- follower is a relation not a mood

Name: Selected
Keywords: selected; routed; active expert; chosen; top-k; activated
Static Encoding: role-accent stroke one step heavier than the element's CURRENT stroke weight -- relative to what it is already drawn at; never a fixed step over the base --stroke-w
Color Guidance: stroke = role accent; others stay base
Reduced-Motion Fallback: accent stroke persists; glow stops
Use When: MoE expert routed for this token; shard chosen by the router; A/B arm taken
Don't: never accent-color alone -- the weight step is the second channel; pair with the routing weight label when known

Name: Idle
Keywords: idle; unselected; dormant; inactive; not routed; spare
Static Encoding: whole body at 35% opacity; no chip
Color Guidance: all tokens unchanged -- opacity does the work
Reduced-Motion Fallback: identical -- static by definition
Use When: MoE experts not routed; standby capacity shown for contrast with is-selected
Don't: never animate idle -- stillness IS the meaning; never drop below 35% opacity (must stay legible)

Name: Cache Hit
Keywords: cache hit; cached; hot data; kv hit; served from cache; memoized
Static Encoding: check tick plus HIT chip on the serving node
Color Guidance: chip fill = role token
Reduced-Motion Fallback: tick and chip persist; hit flash stops
Use When: cache strategy stories; kv-cache reuse in LLM decode
Don't: always show the paired flow-miss path somewhere -- a hit with no visible miss path claims a 100% ratio

Name: Frozen
Keywords: frozen; frozen weights; read only; immutable; locked; not trainable
Static Encoding: dashed border 4 4 plus FROZEN chip
Color Guidance: fill dimmed one step; stroke = role token
Reduced-Motion Fallback: identical -- static by definition
Use When: LoRA base weights; immutable snapshots; read-only replicas in migration stories
Don't: never conflate with is-down -- frozen is healthy and deliberate

Name: Active Flow
Keywords: active flow; primary path; traffic; request path; live; hot path
Static Encoding: solid stroke at normal width -- the default moving path
Color Guidance: edge uses its role stroke
Reduced-Motion Fallback: solid stroke; packets parked at destination
Use When: the primary animated path of the beat; what the motion budget is spent on
Don't: never animate more than the budgeted edges -- secondary paths stay static

Name: Blocked Flow
Keywords: blocked; denied; rejected; stopped; barred; forbidden
Static Encoding: X tick at the block point; packet parked immediately before it; reason chip from the solution sheet
Chip Text: DENIED (or the status code from the solution sheet)
Color Guidance: X tick = error role
Reduced-Motion Fallback: identical -- the parked packet IS the resting state
Use When: authz denials; firewall drops; admission rejected
Don't: the block point must sit ON the guard component -- a floating X claims nothing

Name: Retrying Flow
Keywords: retry; retrying; backoff; reattempt; retry storm; loop back
Static Encoding: dashed stroke with a visible loop-back curl near the failing end
Color Guidance: edge role stroke; curl may take error role after max attempts
Reduced-Motion Fallback: dashed stroke and curl persist; loop animation stops
Use When: transient failure handling; backoff stories; DLQ feeders
Don't: always show where retries END (max attempts to DLQ or give-up) -- an endless loop is an anti-pattern claim

Name: Broken Flow
Keywords: broken; circuit open; severed; tripped; failing calls; cut
Static Encoding: visible gap in the middle of the path; error-role stroke on both stubs
Color Guidance: stroke = error role
Reduced-Motion Fallback: gap persists; flicker stops
Use When: circuit breaker open; severed dependency; partition between peers
Don't: the gap must be geometric (two stubs) not just a color change -- color-only encoding is banned

Name: Backpressure
Keywords: backpressure; congested; queue buildup; upstream pressure; slow consumer; bottleneck
Static Encoding: packets clustered toward the source; stroke widening toward the congested end
Color Guidance: edge role stroke; cluster may take accent
Reduced-Motion Fallback: packet cluster parked near source
Use When: slow consumer stories; buffer growth; why the queue exists
Don't: pair with the consumer's is-overloaded or the claim has no cause shown

Name: Attention Weights
Keywords: attention; attention weights; many to one; weighted edges; softmax scores; token links
Static Encoding: many-to-one thin strokes with stroke-width proportional to weight -- the width IS the encoding
Color Guidance: neutral --stroke at graded widths; heaviest may take role accent
Reduced-Motion Fallback: identical -- static by definition
Use When: transformer attention maps; weighted aggregation of any kind
Don't: never animate weights (shimmer at most on opacity); never equal-width edges with only labels carrying weight

Name: Cache Miss
Keywords: cache miss; miss; fallthrough; origin fetch; cold path; not cached
Static Encoding: dashed detour path to the origin plus MISS chip
Color Guidance: detour uses async role stroke
Reduced-Motion Fallback: dashed detour and chip persist
Use When: the fallthrough path paired with is-cached; origin fetch cost stories
Don't: always annotate the cost difference (latency or rate) -- the miss path exists to show the price
